text:
I don't hold glirol, and I couldn't find a recipe for it. I'm stopping here rather than spending more turns on guesses.

I found three recipes:
- doudrur on its own makes glavruzael.
- lugli on its own makes naeviozhum.
- tepitil, thegen, tepitil placed in an L shape make drinefoun.

I crafted one of each, but none of the combinations I tried with them produced glirol.
